Before you contact us

Questions are welcome

Here are answers to a few common questions.

What kind of businesses do you work with?+

Growing businesses with an active customer journey or recurring operational work: professional firms, commerce businesses, schools, non-profits and organisations that need their website, workflows and business tools to work together.

Do I need to know exactly what I need?+

No. You only need to explain the problem or the goal. We will help you work out what should be done first.

Can you work with an existing website or system?+

Usually, yes. We can review, improve, connect and keep improving websites, workflows and tools built by another provider.

Do you offer ongoing work?+

Yes. A monthly partnership gives your business an agreed capacity each month to keep improving the website, customer journey, automations and connected tools.

Do you provide IT support, device repair or cybersecurity?+

No. Dakyworld focuses on digital systems and automation. We do not provide office hardware support, device repair, network installation or managed cybersecurity services.

Where are you based?+

We are based in Kumasi, Ghana, and work remotely with businesses across Ghana and West Africa.

Dakyworld is your outsourced digital systems and automation team for growing businesses in Ghana and West Africa. We build, connect and improve the systems that help businesses win customers and operate more efficiently.
